title: HaBDaC Origins
description: This datapack adds 6 Origins focued on Light/Protection/Healing or Darkness/Destruction, based off the world of my original story Half a Blessing, Double a Curse
body:
This datapack adds 6 Origins themed around either Light/Protection/Healing or Darkness/Destruction to the Origins mod.

Would you rather heal your allies or explode the blocks around you? Summon lights or damage anything that gets too close? Unlike the characters in my original story _Half a Blessing, Double a Curse_, which these origins are based on, the choice is up to you! Gain strength and abilities beyond a normal player, perhaps even choose to be the very beings that give humans these abilities...
